title: Jesus in His Father's House
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: When Jesus was twelve, His family went to Jerusalem for the Passover. It was a holiday to remember how Heavenly Father saved His people.
On the way home, they thought Jesus was in the big group. But at day’s end, He was not there!
They hurried back and looked for three days. At last they found Jesus in the temple. He was listening to the teachers and asking questions.
p2: Everyone was amazed at what He understood. Mary said, “We were so worried!” Jesus said, “I must be doing My Father’s work.” He meant Heavenly Father. Then He went home and obeyed them.
Mary and Joseph kept looking until they found Jesus. Tonight, you can look for Him too, when you pray.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
